name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Humanity
source:
It's hard to be a vampire. It's even harder to stay human. Save your brethren from sinking into the darkness so that you don't sink yourself. 

[From [url=https://kajancollaboration.itch.io/humanity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当吸血鬼很难。保持人性就更难了。拯救你的弟兄免于沉入黑暗，这样你自己就不会沉没。

[来自[url=https://kajancollaboration.itch.io/humanity]Itch.io[/url]]
